items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Fred Beckett was there and I took his place, that's how it was.

ctx.x: I see. What were the circumstances of his needing a trombone player?

Fred Beckett was in there for a while and I think he left to go to Lionel Hampton -- I don't remember just what -- I know that Beckett died quite early. But right now, I can't recall, but Fred Beckett was there and I took his place, that's how it was.
Did you get a chance to solo, you know, like a featured soloist with Harlan Leonard? Did you get a chance to solo?
